Each card gives the role as the sources describe it and the basis for it. Open the list under a card to see the timeline entries
where that institution is named. A role marked **draft** comes from the EPİAŞ handbook or a news item and was not read in the law itself.

## Who is named in which area

The number of timeline entries in which an institution is named, by area. It counts mentions in this list of milestones;
it is not a measure of how important an institution is.
